title: Missing Number
statement:
Given an array nums containing n distinct numbers in the range [0, n], return the only number in the range that is missing from the array.

Follow-up: Could you implement a solution using only O(1) extra space complexity and O(n) time complexity?
constraints: All the numbers in nums are unique

visibleExamples.explanation: Array contains numbers 0, 1, 3. The missing number in range [0, 3] is 2.
Array contains numbers 0, 1. The missing number in range [0, 2] is 2.
Array is missing 8 from the range [0, 9].
